name: Source Control
description: Git source control panel — branches, staging, commits, stash, and history — plus a review workbench for branch compare, changed-file graphs, and review handoff markdown.
author: contex

actions.name: refresh
actions.description: Refresh git status, branches, and history

actions.name: getStatus
actions.description: Get current git status as JSON. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: getBranches
actions.description: List git branches. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: getLog
actions.description: Get commit history. Params: { workspacePath: string, max?: number }

actions.name: getStashes
actions.description: List stashes. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: commit
actions.description: Create a commit. Params: { workspacePath: string, message: string }

actions.name: stageFile
actions.description: Stage a file. Params: { workspacePath: string, path: string }

actions.name: unstageFile
actions.description: Unstage a file. Params: { workspacePath: string, path: string }

actions.name: stageAll
actions.description: Stage all changed files. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: unstageAll
actions.description: Unstage all files. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: checkoutBranch
actions.description: Switch branch. Params: { workspacePath: string, branch: string }

actions.name: createBranch
actions.description: Create new branch. Params: { workspacePath: string, name: string }

actions.name: pull
actions.description: Git pull from remote. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: push
actions.description: Git push to remote. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: stash
actions.description: Stash current changes. Params: { workspacePath: string, message?: string }

actions.name: stashPop
actions.description: Pop latest stash. Params: { workspacePath: string }

actions.name: getGitState
actions.description: Return current branch, upstream/ahead-behind, working-tree status, recent history, compare summary, and changed-file graph. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }

actions.name: compareBranches
actions.description: Compare two refs without switching branches. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef: string, headRef?: string }

actions.name: getChangedFileGraph
actions.description: Return graph nodes/edges for files changed between refs. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef: string, headRef?: string }

actions.name: generateReviewHandoff
actions.description: Generate markdown review handoff without writing files. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }

actions.name: writeReviewHandoff
actions.description: Write review handoff markdown under .codesurf/reviews. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }

actions.name: getFileDiff
actions.description: Return bounded diff for a file between refs or the working tree. Params: { workspacePath: string, path: string, staged?: boolean, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }

mcpTools.name: git_state
mcpTools.description: Return MCP-readable git state, status, recent commits, branch compare, and changed-file graph. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }

mcpTools.name: branch_compare
mcpTools.description: Compare refs and return changed files/commits without changing checkout. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef: string, headRef?: string }

mcpTools.name: changed_file_graph
mcpTools.description: Return markdown summary of changed-file graph for a ref comparison. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef: string, headRef?: string }

mcpTools.name: review_handoff
mcpTools.description: Return markdown review handoff for a branch/ref comparison. Params: { workspacePath: string, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }

mcpTools.name: file_diff
mcpTools.description: Return a bounded diff for one file between refs. Params: { workspacePath: string, path: string, baseRef?: string, headRef?: string }
